note: No structural proposals remain. This fragment now audits with zero FAILs and its own share of the duplicate-name warnings resolved; the only things left are cross-fragment merges, which are listed below, and a note about the fixes table. The two shared commodities (chem.natural-gas, chem.petroleum) keep one children edge each, from the `chem` branch root, which scripts/audit.mjs now recognises as a legitimate owner (UTIL_OWNERS); every ingredient reference to them, from all fragments, is a 'from' edge. Fourteen duplicate-name pairs remain, and in each case the petrochemical node is the canonical, richer one, so the merge is always 'fold the sibling into mine' - except where a published `shared` entry in another fragment is the canonical node, which is called out.

Preserve loser fab-use prose (sputter/anneal/leak-detect/cryopump) to survivor note. Zero-edge triage A2, centrally arbitrated: survivor reached and decomposed, no prior merge record conflicts.

Same ferric-chloride Cu-etch operation at branch-head vs board-shop level; survivor already consumes etchant and carries the regeneration step (anchored batch-2 part 1), so no content loss. Upholds the banked pcb-etching merge-flag. Batch-2 triage, centrally arbitrated.

Same polymerisation-grade monomer from the same extractive unit (99.0-99.7%); sounsby produces leg already re-pointed to survivor only (duplicate dropped pre-merge), analytical-methods prose folded into survivor note. Batch-2 triage, centrally arbitrated.

Same thing at the same level (CHECKLIST 4): both are bulk Argon material, fluids/gases, chain scope. Keep-rule picks facility.argon: richer description plus facts (0.93% + 99.99%) and 2 sources vs 1, a uses edge to the argon column, 8 inbound (logic fab bays, epi/metal/sputter, crystal fill, gases hub) vs 3, canonical published node per the 35-logic fragment comment, and the more general id. Loser has no facts and no children; its made-from atmospheric-air duplicates the survivor's, so nothing structural is lost (use-side sputter/anneal prose is archived in _merged and partly covered by facility.argon.uses). Repoints 3 consumes edges: metal.steel.ladle, metal.silica.czochralski, metal.chromium.aod. Purity figures conflict only in hedged notes (99.99% vs 99.999%, both not-established).
